lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, forming discernible vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal alignments of circular blobs to form a rectilinear pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity upper edges and dark shadow-casting lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the anterior base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark silhouettes (commensal fish) positioned ventrally and trailing the primary pectoral fin.
